content.user_title: Create and Edit Editable PowerPoint Presentations
content.value_statement: Presentation creation and revisions require consistent layouts, accurate data, and careful review. This skill coordinates local xdoc workflows for editable decks and validation evidence.
actual_capabilities: Create native editable PPTX decks from briefs, outlines, and structured content using bundled DeckKits.
Inspect slide objects and apply targeted edits with dry runs, edit contracts, and retained evidence.
Translate or refurbish existing presentations through dedicated preparation, comparison, and delivery workflows.
Populate native charts and tables from structured data and apply brand or theme changes.
Export PDF or PNG previews and combine structural checks with visual review.
Inspect runtime capabilities, diagnose license authorization, and preserve unsupported animation or object features.
limitations: Requires a separately available xdoc runtime; licensing and disclosed capabilities determine which operations can run.
PowerPoint-native opening, screenshot, and playback checks require macOS, Microsoft PowerPoint, and additional local permissions or tools.
HTML and PDF inputs become source material, not automatic pixel-identical PowerPoint conversions.
Complex animations and unsupported objects may require preservation; visual review and asset-license verification remain necessary.

use_cases.title: Prepare Business Reviews
use_cases.description: Turn approved metrics and an outline into an editable review deck with native charts and validation reports.

use_cases.title: Refresh Client Presentations
use_cases.description: Apply authorized brand changes and targeted content updates while comparing the candidate against the original presentation.

use_cases.title: Localize Training Slides
use_cases.description: Translate an existing training deck, review text fit, and retain comparison evidence before publishing a new file.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-slide PowerPoint about [topic] for [audience]. Use only these facts: [facts]. Save a new editable PPTX and review its previews.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create from a short brief.

prompt_templates.title: Update Selected Slides
prompt_templates.prompt: Update [input.pptx] with these changes: [changes]. Inspect targets, preserve other content, run dry-run checks, and save a separate reviewed output.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Data Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Build [slide count] slides from [data file] using [DeckKit]. Include native charts and tables, verify values, and retain validation evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: generate a structured data presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Translate With Delivery Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Translate [input.pptx] into [language]. Preserve unsupported objects, compare source and candidate, review text fit, and disclose unavailable PowerPoint-native checks.

output_examples.input: Create a quarterly review from approved revenue and customer metrics.
output: An editable PowerPoint with an executive summary, KPI overview, native revenue chart, and next steps.
PNG previews and retained validation reports with unresolved issues disclosed.

output_examples.input: Translate an existing training presentation into English without changing its factual content.
output: A separate translated PowerPoint with text-fit review.
Source-to-candidate comparison images and a delivery summary identifying checks that passed or could not run.

output_examples.input: Change the cover title and update one chart while preserving other slides.
output: A new PowerPoint containing the scoped edits.
Dry-run, edit-contract, and comparison evidence covering the changed objects.

best_practices: Provide approved facts, source files, target language, and output requirements before generation.
Keep original decks unchanged and use a new output path with a dedicated evidence directory.
Review rendered slides and verify chart values, asset permissions, and any skipped native checks.
anti_patterns: Treating a successful command exit as proof of visual quality or PowerPoint playback compatibility.
Loading untrusted JavaScript content modules instead of data-only JSON.
Overwriting source decks or deleting retained evidence before the candidate passes review.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when local execution tools and the xdoc runtime are available.

faq.question: Does it create editable PowerPoint files?
faq.answer: It targets native editable PPTX objects. Imported media and unsupported objects retain their own editing limits.

faq.question: Is the xdoc runtime included?
faq.answer: A working local xdoc runtime is required separately. Its license and reported capabilities determine available operations.

faq.question: Can it convert a PDF or website directly into a finished deck?
faq.answer: PDF and HTML sources are normalized into content first. The deck still requires planning, generation, validation, and visual review.

faq.question: Does every workflow require Microsoft PowerPoint?
faq.answer: Baseline xdoc workflows do not require PowerPoint-native checks. Those checks need a supported macOS setup and must be disclosed when unavailable.

faq.question: Can it preserve complex animation and embedded objects?
faq.answer: Unsupported features are preserved by default. Editing and playback claims depend on current runtime support and the evidence actually collected.
